grammar.exp_entry_store: optional binary64 entry store for x87 only; other providers require binary64 entry by definition
grammar.sites: Four independent strict/stored-PC64/resident-PC64 arithmetic sites per template. Each site occurs exactly once; root set propagation is an exact Cartesian union.

grammar.constant_certificate: constants.py uses exact Machin/alternating-series pi bounds and correctly rounded Decimal ln/sqrt widened by one decimal ULP; both rational endpoints force the same RN53/RN64 constant. No Excel answers are inputs.
additional_forms: General x87/CRT/fdlibm power(mean,1/-1/2) followed by exp(-mean) and multiplication/division
Explicit branch: when scaled exponential is exactly zero, evaluate exp(ln(mean)-mean) to avoid intermediate underflow; otherwise divide/multiply by mean. No empirical cutoff.
grammar.branch_semantics: The actual scaled value selects the branch and is reused in the regular result. Arithmetic site sets of scaled, fallback and normalize subtrees are disjoint; generic root-set propagation preserves this correlation. Models of inactive branch sites remain part of complete candidate descriptions. All unary arguments/constants/providers are explicit in typed AST.
grammar.additional_log_forms: Every direct ln(mean) leaf additionally admits -ln(1/mean), with the reciprocal computed in strict/stored-PC64/resident-PC64 arithmetic; logarithm receives its full tagged value when the provider supports extended entry.
grammar.additional_normalizers: Every sqrt(2*pi) constant leaf additionally admits runtime sqrt(TAU), TAU loaded as certified RN53 or RN64 and sqrt in strict binary64, stored PC64 or resident PC64. Only serialized-equal graphs are deduplicated; equal finite predictions are not equivalence claims.
